name: Sonne Finance
summary: The Compound-v2 exchange-rate calculation let a direct VELO donation inflate the value of two wei of soVELO in an almost-empty market, which the attacker used as collateral to borrow assets from other Sonne markets.
notes: Direct deployment of the vulnerable non-delegating soVELO market runtime.
Sonne Finance reported an approximately $20 million gross loss from the coherent two-transaction donation-attack campaign. The report does not publish a complete asset-by-asset valuation ledger.
The project reports an approximate campaign total rather than an asset-by-asset valuation ledger.
